### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves. E.g., *I'm always frustrated when...*

### Proposed Solution / Feature Specification
Describe the solution you'd like to see:
- Architectural changes (API endpoints, worker queues, DB models)
- UI/UX changes
- Security / scalability impact

### Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### Target Personas
- [ ] Technical Recruiters & HR Organizations
- [ ] Engineering Managers / Interviewers
- [ ] Assessment Candidates
- [ ] System Administrators / DevOps Engineers

### Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or architectural diagrams here.
